title: The Choir of the Weeping Wood Anew
author: Ansel Reyes
blurb: Coral Brightwater, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
